_notes.source: Live lucidtrading.com read in Chrome on 2026-10-20: homepage plan cards (https://lucidtrading.com/#plans - every plan tab, size, daily-loss ON/OFF and LucidDaily EOD/Intraday option clicked through), /affiliate/, /about-us/ and /disclaimer-of-liability-refunds-and-chargeback-policy/. Rules otherwise from the official help centre (support.lucidtrading.com), fetched 2026-10-03; article list in git history.
_notes.pricing: All prices USD, one-time fees. standard = the crossed-out price on each plan card. promo = the 'w/ coupon at checkout' price with the daily loss limit switched ON (the cards' default), which includes a 'limited time' extra saving of $15-$60 for keeping the daily loss limit on. Code shown on the page: VAULT ('for the best deal'). Daily loss limit OFF, with coupon: LucidPro $90.60 / $140.40 / $225.40 / $300.50; LucidFlex $65.30 / $105.20 / $215.60 / $295.40; LucidDaily EOD $90.10 / $125.20 / $200.40 / $280.50; LucidDaily Intraday $80.30 / $105.60 / $170.30 / $235.60. LucidDirect has no daily-loss option. Reset fee equals the discounted price shown (e.g. LucidPro 25K $70 with DLL on, $90 off).
_notes.billing: One-time fee, no subscription and no automatic rebilling; resets must be bought. No activation fee to move from evaluation to funded.
_notes.rules_detail: All sizes allow 2 / 4 / 6 / 10 minis (or 10x micros). LucidFlex: profit target $1,250 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000, EOD trailing max loss $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,500, 50% consistency in the evaluation, optional daily loss limit at checkout ($600 / $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700 when switched on, per the plan cards 2026-10-20). Funded payouts need 5 days each with at least $100 / $150 / $200 / $250 profit; up to 5 payouts, then moved live. LucidPro: same targets and max loss, daily loss limit $600 / $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700 (the 25K now shows $600 on the plan card, 2026-10-20) unless turned off at checkout for a higher price; can pass in one trading day; 40% consistency applies to funded payouts only. LucidDaily: same targets and max loss, 50% consistency in the evaluation, daily loss limit $600 / $1,200 / $1,800 / $2,700 on both phases unless turned off at checkout; evaluation drawdown is EOD or intraday (your choice), funded is always intraday; no per-payout cap but a maximum daily profit of $6,000 / $8,000 / $10,000 / $12,000 moves you live. LucidDirect: no evaluation; EOD trailing max loss $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $5,000; fixed daily loss limit none / $1,200 / $2,100 / $3,000 plus a scaling limit of 60% of peak EOD balance; 20% consistency on payouts; payout profit goal $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 for payout 1, then $1,250 / $2,500 / $3,500 / $4,500. Drawdown on all plans locks at starting balance + $100.
_notes.payout_caps: LucidFlex: 50% of profit up to $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 on every request (recorded as payout_cap). LucidPro: payout 1 up to $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000, payouts 2+ up to $1,500 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $3,500. LucidDirect: payouts 1-3 up to $1,000 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $3,000, payouts 4-5 up to $1,000 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $3,500. LucidDaily: no per-request cap. Minimum request $500 on all plans.
_notes.profit_split: 90/10 on every funded plan from the first payout (help centre). Accounts bought before 28 Nov 2025 had 100% on the first $10K; not relevant to new buyers.
_notes.fee_refund: Refund policy (live, 2026-10-20): strict no-refund policy once an account has been traded; untraded accounts may be refunded at Lucid's discretion. Nothing says the fee is refunded with a payout, so fee_refund = false.
_notes.min_trading_days: LucidPro: 'Pass the evaluation in one trading day' = 1. LucidFlex and LucidDaily: no minimum is stated, although the 50% consistency rule means at least two days in practice; left null. LucidDirect: none stated; left null.
_notes.not_listed: LucidMaxx (invite-only, live from the start, eval price $110-$680 depending on how many live accounts the trader has blown) and LucidBlack (legacy, no longer sold) are not listed.
_notes.company: Terms of use: website operated by Lucid Trading Group LLC. About page footer (June 2026): 3500 S Dupont Hwy, Dover DE 19901 (this is a common registered-agent address, so it may not be a real office). Copyright line reads '2024-2026', but no official page states a founding date, so founded = null. Not related to any firm already listed.
_notes.affiliate_program: Still CLOSED to applications on the live site (2026-10-20): 'Applications are closed... Our team scouts partners directly' based on trading credibility, genuine community, brand alignment and consistency; no form, no DM inbox. No commission %, cookie length or payout method published. A comparison site would have to be approached by Lucid.
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official Lucid page we could read. Prices especially need screenshots.
_notes.company_check: Re-checked 2026-10-20 on the live About page and footer: no founding date stated (footer copyright '2024-2026'), so founded stays null. No Google Business listing found.

firm.name: Lucid Trading
firm.about: Lucid Trading is a US futures-only prop firm offering one-time-fee evaluations (LucidFlex, LucidPro and LucidDaily) and a straight-to-funded LucidDirect account, in sizes from $25K to $150K, with a 90% profit split on funded accounts.

countries.notes: Applies to citizens as well as residents. The regions of Crimea, Sevastopol, Donetsk, Luhansk and Kherson are also listed (no separate codes). Kosovo is recorded as XK (a widely used code, not an official ISO one). The help centre lists 'Papua' and 'New Guinea' on separate lines; recorded as Papua New Guinea. The United Arab Emirates and the United States are not on the list.
